title: Understanding the Plot
text: Notice how the plot shows a U-shape. This is typical of a bias-variance tradeoff, where the error decreases to a minimum point and then increases again. Think about what this might mean for the y-axis.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: In the context of machine learning, as the complexity of the model increases, the bias decreases but the variance increases. Consider how this tradeoff might be represented on the y-axis.
